judge.rationale: The candidate never actually edited `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` to move `beforeSession` inside the `try` block, meaning the bug remains completely unfixed and the newly added acceptance tests will fail. In `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, the candidate added a brief bullet under the wrong section ('Engine startup'), failed to remove the recorded-flaw line under 'Measured semantics — out of scope', and did not document what `afterSession` can assume about how much of the turn happened. Additionally, the candidate completely omitted the required `CHANGELOG.md` entry and left a temporary `.lore/dod.md` file in the diff. Finally, the tests were added in a separate top-level acceptance test file rather than alongside the existing hook unit tests in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts`.
